purpose: Local possible-speech interference screen, separate from broad-family CLAP hints and data-center source identification

runtime.execution: WASM, one thread, sequential, fixed SIMD

policy.source: Pinned upstream defaults; fixed before development sample predictions

preprocessing: Mono Float32, deterministic SciPy1.15.3-equivalent polyphase Kaiser(beta5) FIR to16k, no normalization or denoising, final inference frame zero padding only, context/state reset per recording
startupSelfTest: 32 frames of deterministic zero input against a fixed numeric reference with1e-5 maximum absolute error; software test only, not field validation
limits: Model output can miss quiet, distant, masked or brief speech and can flag non-speech incorrectly.
An empty interval list means no speech flagged, not verified absence of speech.
Speech screening does not verify a data-center source, correct target capture or microphone fidelity.
Current INVC development checks are one provider cluster with unknown independent facility/session identity.
